verdict.rationale: The firm's own 'Seed, venture and growth financings' page states deal volume: 1,600+ venture financings and $45B+ raised for company clients since 2023, plus a PitchBook most-active ranking. The late-stage page adds $100B+ in financings since 2020 and names representative deals such as Anthropic's $65B Series H. Together these cover the seed-to-late-stage span with volume and named transactions. Missing for 10: explicit description of priced equity (preferred-stock) rounds at seed stage rather than only SAFEs/notes at pre-seed, company-side representative seed/Series A deal examples (the named deals are investor-side), and independent corroboration beyond the firm's own pages.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm's venture financing practice covers priced equity rounds from seed through late stage, with stated deal volume or representative transactions on its own pages
